title: Linux web app with App Service plan
description: App Service plan and a Linux web app with a system-assigned managed identity. HTTPS only, TLS 1.2, FTP and basic-auth publishing off. Optional VNet integration for outbound traffic.
security_defaults: HTTPS only; TLS 1.2 minimum (site and SCM); FTP/FTPS disabled
Basic-auth publishing (FTP and WebDeploy) disabled; remote debugging off
System-assigned managed identity for access to other services
Public access is ON by default because web apps are usually internet-facing; the strict (production) policy requires it off plus a private endpoint, and a Premium v3 plan

sku_name.description: Plan size. Production policy requires a Premium v3 (P*v3) size.

public_network_access_enabled.description: Reachable from the internet. Set false and add a private-endpoint (subresource 'sites') for internal apps.

vnet_integration_subnet_id.description: Subnet (delegated to Microsoft.Web/serverFarms) for outbound traffic. Not available on B1.

health_check_path.description: Path the platform probes, for example /healthz.

app_settings.description: Non-secret application settings. Never put secrets here: use Key Vault references.

outputs.identity_principal_id: Managed identity object ID (grant it roles on what the app needs)
